iteration_result.rationale: Exactness passed, but per-layer asynchronous task construction reduced B throughput by 17.11% versus the comparable retained Tier-1 reference.

root_cause_conclusion.rationale: Cross-ring copies remained exact, but creating and joining tasks per layer overwhelms their potential overlap. A persistent bounded worker is the next distinct implementation test.

next_hypothesis.single_primary_hypothesis: Use one persistent provider-owned auxiliary worker for device-1 staging while the request thread stages device 0, retaining serial order within each ring and canonical finalization.
next_hypothesis.predicted_tps_change: B Mode-P decode TPS +3% or better versus retained Iteration 11; A within 3%
next_hypothesis.predicted_trace_change: B stage service -20% or better and B provider wall -5% or better
next_hypothesis.falsifier: Revert if the Iteration-12 regression is not removed, B TPS improves less than 3% over Iteration 11, stage/provider targets miss, or any exactness, generation, cancellation, lifecycle, or bounded-resource gate regresses.
